bayts.text: O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "Powerful" (Al-Qadīr) and "Wise" (Al-Ḥakīm),
bless with a blessing, with a peace that has no end, him through whom You led to me what is desired,
by his mighty standing with You, without guile or reckoning, or any such trial.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward him on my behalf with a good that has been for none but him, without end, by the word "Be".
And bear witness for me today that I am Your servant, his servant, before all Your hosts.
And reward also the people of Badr, on my behalf, with a surpassing good, O Mighty in favour.
O Allah, O Eternal Refuge, truly You are the One (al-Aḥad), and You have led Your bounty to me since Sunday (al-aḥad).
Bless and grant peace perpetually upon the Prophet, sincere counsellor of every near one and stranger,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bear witness for me, forever, to praise and gratitude, and contentment in You and from You, O Appreciative.
You have accepted for me (the service) from the year Asash (1301 AH / 1883-84) to Balsash (1332 AH / 1913-14), informing me of it in the year Lasash (1330 AH / 1911-12).
O best of those to whom the poor have turned, and best of those in whom the lowly found comfort,
You have made me free, through You, of lords, and through Muḥammad of (secondary) causes.
Bless and grant peace perpetually upon him, with his Family and whoever is linked to him
among his Companions and the Followers, worshippers for Your mighty Day, O You Who are worshipped.
You have comforted me in You, with the Book and Your servant, the Light, without reproach.
To You my gratitude until the Gardens (al-jinān), and for me You have made the soul good like the heart (al-janān).
O best of those to whom a hand is stretched: there has yielded to me from You, for the Gardens, what most profits.
O Lord of the earths and the lofty heavens, O You to Whom all creation together belongs, O You Who are exalted,
bless with a blessing and a guarded peace, glad tidings the like of which is not uttered,
upon Your Prophet, the Messenger, Your servant, the most excellent of those who led Your hosts to You,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
just as through him You have made my tongue upright for me, and led me to You with the fair (works).
O You Who through him have illumined my heart, and led to me provisions for the Gardens,
bless, O All-Merciful, with peace, him who attained the converse (with Allah),
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward through him, on my behalf, my parents, O You Who through him have mended my affair, folding it up.
And make my life, for him, perpetual gladness, and accept my piety with thanks.
And bless, O Most Merciful, perpetually, our master Muḥammad, giver of heights,
through You, and grant peace perpetually upon him, in his Family and his Companions with him.
He is the one through whom You dispelled the pitch-dark night from every wayfarer, man and woman,
and he led with faith, Islām and the finest excellence (iḥsān), possessed of submission;
and he made truth manifest and helped Your religion, bearer of glad tidings and warner, just as he triumphed.
And make through him my presented letters accepted, a magnified blessing.
And make its letters glad tidings that illumine the heart of whoever blesses with them, O Illuminer.
And raise the renown of whoever blesses with them, console his mind and expand his breast.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "Sovereign" (Al-Malīk) and "King" (Al-Malik),
bless with peace him who was given dominion, master of every human and every angel,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who through him have fulfilled my need, and through him led to me the tongue of the Arabs,
lead to him sweetness and nourishment, O You Who through my expression have put the ruby to shame.
And through my writing lead to him what increases gladness with You, O Everlasting, ever growing.
O You Who have made my ink like the blood of those who, with him, were martyrs among the early ones,
since You have made my blessings fold up the journey for me, containing Your good pleasure,
through him; and You have put swords and spears to shame with that with which I praised him, O Possessor of magnanimity.
Toward me You have led the blessings of Allah, O You Who through him have protected me from the heedless.
And for me, by (the Name) "the All-Merciful", You have drawn benefit without harm, and for me You have prevailed;
and by (the Name) "the Most Merciful" You have been for me without reckoning, O You Who make all my being the best of merits (with You).
So bless, on my behalf, forever, and grant peace upon the Prophet; and be for me, and teach (me).
O Allah, bless and grant peace forever, on my behalf, upon him who led to You whoever has worshipped,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bless, O All-Merciful, and grant peace upon the Prophet and Messenger, my ladder,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And drive toward others than my body and my spirit the adversities of the two Abodes, O You Who give me rest.
And drive corruption toward other than what I possess, and do not turn enemies and enviers toward me.
And make my creeds, my word and deed the best of benefits, and drive hope toward me.
And in what You make lawful for me, grant me what the righteous before me did not attain.
And bless, O Most Merciful, and grant peace upon him who benefits the saints and the learned,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who have effaced forever the turning of reckoning toward me, and I have become one of merit (with You),
O Lord, I cannot enumerate Your praise: You are as You have praised Yourself (ḥadīth).
You have attested for me, my Lord, my turning away from what I sold to You, drawing from You,
and You have come between me and harm, and bestowed on me from You the best secret.
To You my gratitude for my prices, O Sovereign Who have given me possession of my time.
None but You enumerates Your praise, O You Who lead wishes to me, O Reckoner (Al-Muḥṣī).
